role: exposed development/regression only; structural context planning and scoped overlay adapter; no inference or fresh model-quality estimate

all_item_structural_accounting.unit: native item ref in texts/pictures/tables/key_value_items/form_items; including hidden children, independent of planner emission

graph_groups.unit: native group ref; body/furniture roots additionally preserved

prior_paragraph_regression.unit: fixed prior source ref/scope; all remain visible even when changed-input responses cannot be replayed

protected_positive_anchors.unit: existing bounded semantic approval, not all 17; no positive relabeling

source_boundary_diagnostics.unit: 3 formula structural envelopes, 1 adjacent code block, SEAL32 context-only formula boundary, SEAL34 multispan/continuation boundary

prior_paragraph_regressions.bounded_positive_scope: F14 selected token/binding/number pass; hyphenation difference remains visible

protected_positive_anchors.positive_scope: F14 selected token/binding/number pass; hyphenation difference remains visible

structural_checks: Account for every all-item native ref with exactly one retained, target, consumed, context-only, or explicitly unresolved role; group refs and body/furniture ordering remain preserved.
Preserve original provider bytes/graph and source hashes; working overlays/deltas are separately attributable.
No duplicate target/consumed spans; context-only refs remain visible and cannot be consumed by replacement; outside selected scopes preserve literal text and ordering.
Every fragment records exact physical page, native provenance/charspan, source bounds and outward clamp/rounding; inverse transforms reproduce source coordinates and rendered pixels.

Three controls formula jobs cover union of picture-parent plus every child provenance, including child extents outside parent; actual pixels retain complete matrix delimiters, fraction structure and two-case structure.
Controls code comment/body refs12+13 remain one uninterrupted source block with both refs accounted once; ref14 remains a separate mixed prose/inline-code source scope.

SEAL34 spans [0,657] and [658,734] remain accounted with join whitespace [657,658]; body34 first span plus continuation45 must be represented once, while second native34 span remains separately visible and associated with parallel algorithm. No silent loss, duplicate continuation, algorithm absorption, or next-paragraph absorption.
All four documents run all-items and prior-selected scopes; unsupported/ambiguous items are explicit, with structural regressions reported per document rather than pooled away.

Reject stale input hashes, bad pages/transforms, overlapping consumed spans, missing outer parent boundaries, duplicate code/comment, context consumption and outside-content deletion using small negative controls.

semantic_checks.source_of_rubrics: Existing source reviews and frozen case semantics referenced above; no new case-specific producer checks or oracle prompt content.
semantic_checks.protected_anchor_rule: Re-evaluate each protected anchor under its existing bounded source rubric; source-positive labels stay fixed. A new abstention, loss, duplication, material semantic error or damaged source mapping blocks adoption. Existing scope limits stay visible, e.g. E04 is not an exact full transcript pass.
semantic_checks.seal32: Saved wrong model identity/subscript/prime output stays rejected or explicitly semantically unapproved if replayed. JSON/schema/brace/root-count/lexical pass or correct context formula never proves target semantics.
semantic_checks.seal34: Source-boundary completeness is separately assessable; prior response with omitted source prose remains semantically unapproved. Native-only preservation is not an F13 completion claim.
semantic_checks.controls: Envelopes/pixels are structural; correct matrix/fraction/piecewise transcript and exact seven-line code are semantic rubrics. Do not equate a valid crop with transcript quality.

exact_compatibility_required: same input bytes/image and fragment order
replay_policy.changed_input_or_scope: Old response may be retained only as a labeled diagnostic/artifact; no attribution to the new candidate and no fresh behavioral model-quality pass.
replay_policy.protected_anchor_when_input_changes: Record structural scope coverage and semantic not evaluated for the new input; preserve old positive label. This does not satisfy a new behavioral regression pass or unlock holdout.
replay_policy.scope_only_adapter_replay: May test old raw responses against their exact old source boundaries/prompt records, with prior bounded semantic labels kept separate from adapter eligibility.

acceptance.structural_candidate: No native-ref/character-scope/outside-content loss or duplication; formula/code envelopes complete; non-vacuous proposed context work on diagnosed boundaries with unsupported choices explicit.
acceptance.blanket_abstention: A planner that suppresses every diagnosed change or silently omits hard multiprov items does not satisfy candidate utility; abstentions stay in fixed denominators.
acceptance.behavioral_adoption: All applicable frozen bounded semantic regressions must remain passed on compatible evaluated inputs before broader adoption; no inference this step means no new model-quality or G2 pass claim.

limits: Four exposed native documents and selected prior scopes only, not holdout or production representativeness.
No model inference/API/GitHub operations; no untouched holdout reads.
Source-only structure checks do not establish general semantic equivalence, full V01-V19 behavior or canonical integration.
